THEENGINEER-CONSUME.title: Consume {Consume}
THEENGINEER-CONSUME.description: Exhaust [blue]{Consume}[/blue] Material {Consume:plural:card|cards} from your hand, unless specified otherwise, to activate an additional effect.
THEENGINEER-CONSUMEALL.title: Consume
THEENGINEER-CONSUMEALL.description: Exhaust Material from your hand, unless specified otherwise, to activate an additional effect.
THEENGINEER-PRODUCE.title: Produce {Produce}
THEENGINEER-PRODUCE.description: Create [blue]{Produce}[/blue] Material {Produce:plural:card|cards} in your hand, unless specified otherwise.
THEENGINEER-STOCK.title: Stock
THEENGINEER-STOCK.description: Your Stock is the total Material in your hand, draw pile, and discard pile.
THEENGINEER-CHARGE_MAX.title: Charge
THEENGINEER-CHARGE_MAX.description: When Material is consumed, this card gains Charge. When it reaches its maximum Charge, its charged effect activates the next time it is played.
